articles.title: Crypto industry cheers Senate Clarity Act markup date as market structure push resumes
articles.snippet: The bill's progress follows talks on jurisdiction, consumer/developer protections, and stablecoin rewards, with crypto firms backing a yield compromise.

articles.title: Emerging-market users are treating crypto exchanges like banking apps, Binance says
articles.snippet: One point three billion adults lack financial services, 4.7 billion lack credit, and 1.4 billion savers in low-income nations earn no deposit interest, Binance said.

articles.title: ECB's Lagarde’s digital euro warning: Why Europe shouldn’t just copy the U.S. stablecoin model
articles.snippet: Lagarde warned that large stablecoins like Tether and USDC, which now dominate a $310 billion market, pose financial stability risks and could transmit stress to underlying asset markets during periods of turmoil.

articles.title: South Korea crypto holdings halve in a year as investors turn to stock market
articles.snippet: South Korean crypto holdings fell to $41 billion from $83 billion in just over a year as investors shifted to stocks.

articles.title: CLARITY Act will help reshore US crypto industry, attorney says
articles.snippet: The "biggest market" in crypto is conducting the vast majority of its trading volume outside of US-based exchanges, according to Attorney Bill Hughes.
